description: Search the TheGamesDB video-game database by title. Returns matching games with platform name, release date, players, rating, and a short overview. Example: search_games({ name: "zelda", limit: 10 })

_apiKey.description: Optional TheGamesDB API key. Omit to use the shared Pipeworx platform key.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 15)

name.description: Game title or keyword to search for, e.g. "zelda", "halo", "final fantasy"

name: search_games
